title: Herbicide waiver for road safety spots deferred
summary: Resolution 26-123 would let Public Works use herbicide at some road safety spots despite county pesticide limits, and one caller opposed it while a member cited runoff into the ocean. The chair deferred the resolution, and a member asked for specific areas and a shorter time period when it returns.

timeline.text: The chair said the herbicide waiver will be deferred.
